events.detail: Observed nightly CI red on the validate job; two prior 'just rerun' attempts did not resolve it.
Retrieved the failing run log excerpt, the changed-file list from the PR, and the local regression command for the validate script.
Proposed two candidates: 'log-backed-minimal-fix' (fix the named step after a local repro) and 'rerun-only-green-wait' (re-trigger the job and hope).
Verifier checked for a captured failing log excerpt, changed-file scoping, and a named regression command; rerun-only had none of the three.
Promoted 'log-backed-minimal-fix'; merging remains blocked until the full required GitHub Actions matrix is green.
